scope: Read-only native Linux cargo tree --offline --locked --edges normal,build for default/net/sfcs/sfcs-risc0/all-features and local pinned source inspection; not a complete exploitability proof or clean security audit.

residual_vulnerabilities.assessment: Resolved in Cargo.lock through optional libp2p DNS/mDNS; absent from normal/build dependency trees for all declared Power House features on native Linux. DNSSEC/encoding advisories remain in full lock audit.
residual_vulnerabilities.resolution: Requires upstream libp2p dependency change; do not enable DNS/mDNS without reassessment.

residual_vulnerabilities.assessment: Active through ark-relations with default-features=false; fmt/ANSI formatting feature is not enabled even in all-features tree. Advisory logging path is not enabled by this package feature set.
residual_vulnerabilities.resolution: Upgrade arkworks only as a separately validated proof compatibility migration; downstream feature unification could change applicability.

residual_vulnerabilities.assessment: RISC Zero includes rzup for installed prover lookup. Inspected RISC Zero call sites use Rzup::new/get_version_dir; Power House does not use RSA private-key signing/decryption. rzup distribution verification uses a public key. No patch listed.
residual_vulnerabilities.resolution: Preserve pinned proof backend; reassess any added rzup publishing/private-key operations.

residual_vulnerabilities.assessment: Transitive decompressor still present via pinned RISC Zero and addr2line. Power House now rejects all compressed sections in both user/kernel ELF components before compute_image_id, graph construction or proving. Aggregate PT_LOAD memory is capped at 64 MiB before the upstream loader allocates zero-fill. These are entry-point mitigations, not a patched upstream crate.
residual_vulnerabilities.resolution: Keep mitigation/regression tests and pinned guest identity; upgrade object/addr2line/RISC Zero through separately validated backend migration.

residual_vulnerabilities.assessment: RISC Zero recursion reads entries by_name/read_exact from an embedded archive whose SHA256 is checked at build time. Inspected code does not call filesystem extract APIs implicated in symlink/permissions advisories.
residual_vulnerabilities.resolution: No forced ZIP major update; preserve pinned recursion artifacts and recheck upstream backend upgrades.

warning_scope.assessment: reed-solomon-erasure 6 cache uses get/put with Vec<usize> keys and Arc<Matrix> values; no pop/pop_entry call found in its source. Advisory panic safety path is not called by the inspected consumer; patched 0.18.2 is not semver compatible.

Via reed-solomon-erasure parking_lot 0.11; maintenance warning remains.
